identities.label: Platform & SRE View
identities.title: Senior Platform Engineer | Distributed Systems & DevEx
identities.summary: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA, 2026) with deep production ownership of distributed caching (Redis Sentinel 3+3, Memcached), event-driven messaging (RabbitMQ), secrets orchestration (HashiCorp Vault), and developer platforms (DevEx). Architect of the 'Halo' non-invasive extensibility framework and upstream contributor to VectorDB-Bench.

description: Modular Extensibility Platform (Project Halo): Co-architected 'Halo', a non-invasive microservice extensibility platform enabling dynamic runtime feature injection and custom workflows without modifying the core monolithic codebase, eliminating regression risks across healthcare SaaS environments.

Internal Developer Portal (DevEx): Architected and delivered 'Config Studio', an Angular self-service configuration portal empowering engineering teams to independently configure, toggle, and deploy dynamic microservice extensions without manual intervention.

API Cryptography & Zero-Trust Security: Hardened authentication and login endpoints by implementing Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) asymmetric encryption; engineered standardized microservice auth middleware to enforce uniform enterprise RBAC protocols.

Distributed Cache HA Architecture: Architected Redis Sentinel (3+3 topology) and Memcached HA from scratch across the microservices ecosystem, eliminating all single points of failure; validated sub-second failovers, memory boundaries, and eviction policies via Locust and Memtier.

CI/CD & Automated Performance Validation: Engineered end-to-end Jenkins pipelines for automated Redis HA and Memcached rollouts across TLS and non-TLS topologies; integrated x.509 certificate provisioning and automated post-deployment performance testing, slashing rollout cycles from 3 weeks to under 24 hours.

Secrets Orchestration & Compliance: Architected a high-availability HashiCorp Vault cluster with AppRole authentication and automated PKI rotation; enforced Redis ACL-based multitenancy and audit logging to satisfy HIPAA compliance mandates.

High-Throughput Messaging Reliability: Overhauled RabbitMQ batch consumer architecture with optimized worker routines and Dead Letter Queues (DLQ), achieving a 200% throughput increase and zero data loss across clinical pipelines.

Enterprise Observability & Open Source: Built enterprise observability stack (Prometheus + Grafana) monitoring 20+ components; authored and upstreamed a bug fix for metric registration conflicts under MongoDB 8.3.x (percona/mongodb_exporter#1285).

AI Infrastructure Benchmarking: Evaluated vector databases (Milvus vs. pgvector) across 1M vectors (1024-dim) for latency, recall, and p99 throughput; contributed a critical benchmark bug fix merged into the official open-source VectorDB-Bench repository.
